arguments.text: James's statement was made while he was testifying on the stand, meaning it was not made out of court.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) defines hearsay as a statement made when the declarant is not testifying at the current trial or hearing.
arguments.evidence_span: James testified on the stand that he was on vacation that day and had last spoken to Emily the week before.

arguments.text: The statement is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted, specifically to determine which employee saw Emily last.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(3) requires the statement to be offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
arguments.evidence_span: On the issue of which employee saw Emily last

arguments.text: The evidence consists of direct in-court testimony given under oath, which is subject to cross-examination and thus falls outside the hearsay rule's purpose.
arguments.legal_rule: The hearsay rule targets out-of-court statements; in-court testimony is not hearsay.
